hints.title: Consecutive Difference Property
hints.text: In an arithmetic progression, the difference between any two consecutive elements is uniform across the entire ordered sequence.

hints.title: Sort and Compare
hints.text: Sort the sequence in ascending order. Then verify that arr[i] - arr[i - 1] equals arr[1] - arr[0] for every adjacent pair.

hints.title: Early Exit Check
hints.text: If any pair difference diverges from the initial step difference, return false immediately.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all N! permutations naively is factorial and infeasible.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting orders elements in O(N log N) time, reducing adjacent difference validation to a single O(N) scan.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies that sorting guarantees consecutive adjacency for any valid arithmetic sequence.
complexity.notes: An O(N) solution using minimum, maximum, and set lookup is also possible.
